g1_availability.name: G1 — AVAILABILITY
g1_availability.rule: Generator safety credit requires generator to be operational OR capable of becoming operational under G1.2, dispatchable, and supported by validated telemetry/evidence.

g2_fuel.name: G2 — FUEL SUFFICIENCY & UNCERTAINTY
g2_fuel.rule: Requires sufficient fuel for 6h survivability interval. Fuel uncertainty makes contribution UNKNOWN/invalid (0.0 kWh credit). UNKNOWN_INVALID != EMERGENCY.

g3_startup.name: G3 — STARTUP TRANSIENTS
g3_startup.rule: OFF generator counts only if validated start-readiness exists and startup delay is validated. Generation credit begins only after startup constraint satisfied. Instantaneous start forbidden for safety credit.

g4_unknown_health.name: G4 — UNKNOWN GENERATOR HEALTH
g4_unknown_health.rule: Unknown health sets generator credit to 0.0 kWh. Evaluates remaining verified resources. Emergency applies ONLY if remaining verified resources yield M_surv < 0.

g5_time_varying_output.name: G5 — TIME-VARYING GENERATOR OUTPUT ENVELOPE
g5_time_varying_output.rule: P_gen_credible(t) accounts for availability, dispatchability, startup delay, fuel depletion, output bounds, derating, operating limits, health evidence.

g1_1_demand_cap.name: G1.1 — CRITICAL-LOAD DEMAND CAP
g1_1_demand_cap.rule: Generator safety credit MUST be capped to remaining critical-load energy requirement (69.60 kWh max). Credit above remaining requirement shall not increase survivability credit.

g1_2_off_generator_dispatchability.name: G1.2 — OFF GENERATOR DISPATCHABILITY
g1_2_off_generator_dispatchability.rule: Dispatchable includes OFF generator ONLY when validated start-readiness exists, unit can become operational under validated startup process, and startup delay is explicitly represented.

g1_3_e_telemetry_freshness.name: G1.3-E — TELEMETRY FRESHNESS
g1_3_e_telemetry_freshness.rule: NO UNIVERSAL NUMERICAL FRESHNESS THRESHOLD. Safety-critical telemetry must be sufficiently fresh under resource-specific, evidence-based research rules. System MUST NOT invent a universal number or default to 30s/300s/900s.

g1_4_telemetry_loss_emergency.name: G1.4 — TELEMETRY LOSS / EMERGENCY
g1_4_telemetry_loss_emergency.rule: If generator telemetry becomes invalid AND verified remaining resources can no longer establish 6h survivability (M_surv < 0) -> enter EMERGENCY. Telemetry invalidity itself is NOT automatically equivalent to Emergency.

g6_evidence_threshold.name: G6 — STRICT EVIDENCE VALIDATION THRESHOLD
g6_evidence_threshold.rule: Every required evidence field for generator safety credit MUST validate. No optimistic defaults. Missing/invalid/stale evidence -> generator receives 0.0 kWh credit. UNKNOWN/INVALID != EMERGENCY.
